description: Add, change, complete or reopen a task in DayHeart. add needs a title (date and time optional; time needs a date). update changes the title, date, time, length, important or urgent. complete marks the task done; reopen marks it not done. A study task is a task with a subject: give subject and type (homework, academic debt, test…) and, if known, where to hand it in and whether the deadline is approximate; set_status moves it through todo → ready (done, not handed in) → sent (handed in, waiting for a grade) → passed (with points), or skip (not needed: archived), with status_source saying where you know it from. source_key (for example moodle:4512 or tg:<chat>:<message>) is the id of the source the task came from: add with a source_key that is already there updates that task instead of adding a second one. notes and private set the task notes and “Only me”.

action.description: What to do with the task

approximate_date.description: Study task: the date is approximate

clarify.description: Study task: something needs to be clarified

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; empty string removes the date

duration_minutes.description: How long the task takes, 1 to 1440 minutes; only with a time

id.description: Task id, for update, complete, reopen and set_status

notes.description: The task's notes, up to 2000 characters; empty string removes them

points.description: Study task: points or grade, up to 20 characters, e.g. "8/10"

private.description: “Only me”: the task is not shared with friends or groups

source_key.description: Id of the source the task came from, e.g. moodle:4512, tg:<chat>:<message>, mail:<id>; the same key later updates the same task

status.description: Study task status: todo, ready (done, not handed in), sent (handed in, waiting for a grade), passed, skip (not needed)

status_source.description: Where you know the status from, up to 160 characters, e.g. "Moodle: Submitted for grading, 14 Nov"

subject.description: Study task: the subject, as in the timetable; empty string makes it a usual task again

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour; needs a date; empty string removes the time

title.description: What to do, up to 180 characters

type.description: Study task: hw (homework), debt (academic debt), test, oral, module (module test or credit), written, org (organizational)

where_to_hand_in.description: Study task: where and how to hand it in, up to 120 characters, e.g. "Moodle, by 23:59"

who.description: Study task: who does it — the user (me) or you (ai)

name: change_tasks
title: Change tasks
